method.label: Bound the frequencies and construct a list

annotationRationale: Uniqueness of the mode caps every other frequency at nine. A universal lower bound on the number of values, followed by a list attaining it, proves the minimum.
sourceMethod: Follows the official frequency-capacity bound and its explicit construction, expressing the rounding step through 223 times 9 rather than ceiling notation.

review.mathCheck: After removing the ten modal entries, 2008 entries remain, with each other value occurring at most nine times. Since 223·9=2007, at least 224 nonmodal values are required. The stated construction has 2018 entries, 225 distinct positive values, and exactly one value occurring ten times. Thus the minimum is 225, choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: An originally worded, faithful adaptation of MAA solution 10 on page 5. It preserves both the frequency-cap lower bound and the attaining construction, replacing ceiling notation with an explicit capacity comparison.
review.annotationCheck: Both assessed concepts are necessary: interpreting a unique mode establishes the cap, and a universal bound plus an attaining example proves the minimum.
